title: Freeze baseline and reconcile authority
scope: Pin the local source tree, live deployment and HAUSSMANN evidence boundary; reconcile MCP built/not-live, G4 and Operations ADR-025. Do not rescore old numbers as if v1.1 produced them.
output: baseline_manifest.md and two isolated v1.1 sheets with reconciliation
test: Every score clause cites a reached surface; two fixed cohort exemplars are scored alongside the target on the same version. Preserve absent human measurements as provisional.
red: Give the manifest validator a mismatched commit and give scorers an evidence pack missing TTFS; neither may report an unqualified full pass.

title: Calibrate the added instruments
scope: Version the consumer word/claim census, complete capture matrix and expanded component population. Reuse existing instruments; route missing reusable patterns back to WebForge.
output: instrument_contract.md, controls and consumer bar manifest
test: Prove every instrument reaches its named route/population and run both failing and passing fixtures before using a verdict.
red: Insert a banned word, overflow paragraph, missing viewport and token bypass into disposable fixtures; each relevant detector must fail separately.

title: Make the homepage demonstrate the mechanism
scope: Edit homepage copy and low-fidelity hierarchy only after P0 exit. Retain Agentic DNA, local ownership and opt-in sharing. Put the real primitive before the supporting DNA/shared-cultural-heritage explanation; show democratic participation through existing artifacts.
test: The rendered home and twin meet the ratified word budget, one-new-term rule and claim register; the working artifact is adjacent to the capability claim.
red: A disposable version containing a fictitious benchmark or undefined second new term must fail editorial review.

title: Bring the first task into focus
scope: Clarify get-started and its immediate explainer path; account for prerequisites, expected result, rollback and provenance credit without inventing timings or terminal output.
test: Read rendered pages and twins, copy exact commands, run the documented task in a disposable environment; keep actual human TTFS owed.
red: Reject a command with a prompt prefix and a fixture with an omitted prerequisite; compare successful output with the documented expectation.

title: Make the public-good invitation concise
scope: Revise about, community, commons and network first-contact prose under existing positioning. Distinguish shared cultural heritage as an ethical thesis from private data, current ownership and future governance. Preserve held third-party text pending its owner decision.
test: Each revised claim has an artifact or an explicit aspiration label; all four prose budgets and standing-reader paths are checked on rendered pages and twins.
red: A fixture calling founder-controlled nodes independent adoption must be rejected; a community instruction for agent transport must be rejected.

title: Show a reproducible example and its lineage
scope: Select one real, public governed vault example and trace a task from source to result. Connect prior art and research lineage at true strength; state absent comparative evaluations honestly. No new lab-performance claims.
output: worked_example.md, reproducibility record and lineage map
test: Reproduce the published example from its pinned public inputs in a disposable directory and follow every lineage citation.
red: Change an expected artifact hash and remove a necessary input; the example verification must fail, while an explicit unknown evaluation remains admissible.

title: Reconcile glossary and community publishing ownership
scope: Enumerate the 25 glossary and 4 community mirrors afresh. Assign an authoritative source/transform or a documented authored exception to every row; repair only website-owned paths.
test: Mutate a disposable source for each transform family and prove corresponding served HTML and Markdown change together; enumerate every mirror with zero unassigned rows.
red: Disable one transform or substitute stale output in a disposable build; the comparison must fail for the affected family.

title: Review the remaining documentation by risk
scope: Derive a full docs inventory, classify tutorial/how-to/reference/explanation and inspect all high-risk instructions, renamed terms and claim-bearing pages. Assign every remaining route to reviewed or a named follow-up tranche before accepting coverage.
test: Every built content route has a disposition; changed examples execute and changed source/HTML/twin triples agree. If the review exceeds this context budget, propose a tranche mission before closing.
red: Seed an obsolete command and orphaned glossary definition in disposable copies; the review must identify both by route.

title: Bring current state and governance beside the invitation
scope: Connect dated state-of-network, people, canonical properties and actual contribution paths from first-contact pages. Make founder operation, proposal authority and unoccupied roles visible without new nav categories or an investor page.
test: Trace each decisive reader from home to people, lineage and state in at most two clicks; compare every institutional assertion with its clearance record.
red: An unapproved institution card and an unsupported external-adopter label must block review; empty-state candor must not be rejected.

title: Measure Decade 1 and ratify the craft wave
scope: Freeze Decade 1 output, run two isolated v1.1 scorers plus the same two cohort exemplars, and re-plan every provisional P3–P6 mission against current findings.
test: Display all dimensions, ceilings and changes in instrument reach; list each provisional mission retained, amended or deferred with its cost and owner.
red: Supply mismatched instrument hashes or omit a scorer; the measure gate must refuse an incomparable composite.

title: Enforce the evolved visual system
scope: Consume WebForge through the local wrapper; honor ADR-059 validators-only tokens and ADR-053 five slots. Inventory actual type roles and component exceptions, then implement ratified consumer constraints and a VisualDNA bundle.
test: Census the declared full component population, inspect design-system plus representative templates in both themes and validate the bundle against its pinned schema.
red: Plant an unapproved token and a bundle missing an a11y field; each relevant validation fails before approving the clean fixture.
pattern: semantic type roles and five-slot VisualDNA bundle

title: Craft the hero and illustration slots
scope: Apply the ratified hierarchy to home and the five approved illustration slots. Abstract-only generated assets if authorized; no fabricated people, institutions or implied deployments. Preserve origin/credit and alt decisions.
test: Inspect all six viewports in both themes, at 200/400% reflow, with art disabled; the same mechanism and task remain available as text.
red: A deliberately cropped key label or missing meaningful alt must fail review; decorative alt remains empty where justified.

title: Unify diagrams and code treatment
scope: Apply one symbol/edge grammar to architecture diagrams and preserve a genuinely equivalent keyboard/text graph twin. Unify code labels, overflow and copy states without faking executable output.
test: Compare graph data with keyboard twin, exercise keyboard navigation and copy each command exactly; test clipboard rejection and narrow-width code overflow.
red: Delete one graph edge from the twin and deny clipboard permission; parity check and accessible recovery behavior must expose the failures.
pattern: diagram semantic grammar and clipboard recovery

title: Finish motion, states and social previews
scope: Inventory and rationalize motion, loading/empty/error states, icons and OG cards across templates; extend the existing visual voice to each. Avoid new third-party scripts unless justified and separately accepted.
test: Exercise normal/reduced motion, no-JS and failed-request states; inspect actual generated OG images for the selected route classes at social-preview dimensions.
red: Block an image or request, force an empty result and emulate reduced motion; each state remains understandable and navigable.

title: Harden performance and field measurement
scope: Run local and deployed lab checks separately; inspect field p75 mobile/desktop access and sample sufficiency. Read provider Lighthouse bars from their owner file, never transcribe them.
output: performance_pack.md and CI payload budget checks
test: Five critical templates meet ratified lab budgets with waterfall evidence; field LCP/INP/CLS are green on a stated sample or explicitly unmeasured at the publication gate.
red: Add an oversized asset in a disposable fixture and remove field sample metadata; budget check fails and the field report refuses a green claim.

title: Verify accessibility beyond automation
scope: Run all-template axe matrices, keyboard flows, zoom/reflow, code/diagram contrast and human VoiceOver/NVDA passes; recruit no users as an agent.
test: Zero automated violations in the enumerated matrix; manual primary flows pass WCAG 2.2 AA checks with named evidence and assistive-tech coverage.
red: Introduce a focus trap, missing label and low-contrast fixture; the corresponding automated/manual protocols detect each.

title: Refresh regression and machine evidence
scope: Grow gates only for demonstrated regression classes; preserve derived fixtures and same-diff updates. Recheck headers, redirects, all internal links, twin parity, registry and self-conformance boundary.
test: Build safely, apply all CI injections, pass fast/full/container gates without new skips or xfails, and reach the final intended origin in live probes.
red: Wrong-origin, missing header, stale twin and broken internal-link fixtures each fail the matching instrument.

title: Run the decisive and standing reader panels
scope: Prepare sealed tasks and practice controls; operator supplies consenting humans. Record independent 3-second and 3-minute answers without coaching, plus clinician, OSS and agent regression paths. Keep HAUSSMANN panel ownership separate.
output: human_panel_pack.md with consent-safe verbatims and denominators
test: At least five per decisive class; ≥80% in every class answer each window correctly under predeclared rubric. Record disagreement and standing-reader failures.
red: Use an ambiguous practice page and an answer that confuses aspiration with fact; the rubric must mark failure rather than award sympathy points.

title: Rescore and prepare the integration handoff
scope: Freeze evidence, run two isolated v1.1 scorers and cohort exemplars, reconcile clause-level differences and prepare a staged integration packet for HAUSSMANN GR-7.
test: No composite without full breakdown, ceilings and provenance; all protected invariants have evidence and all S1/S2 findings have dispositions accepted at gate.
red: Omit a required score clause or substitute an older build pack; reconciliation must refuse sign-off.

title: Present the public-launch decision
scope: Prepare the exact reviewed diff, final evidence manifest, clearance dispositions and rollback plan. Publication remains a separate operator act after HAUSSMANN boundary and GR-7 ownership checks.
test: Confirm source/CI/deployment candidates match, all clearances are recorded and operator explicitly authorizes each outward act; no inferred GO from prior planning.
red: A candidate with a different source hash or an unresolved G4 hold must be rejected before any deploy invocation.

title: Write the full campaign AAR
scope: Write five-line and full-template AARs with complete scorecards, instrument drift, per-session estimates/actuals and both content-load and available API-billing evidence.
test: Reconcile delivered objectives to mission AARs; budget totals derive from records, unavailable billing is stated rather than estimated from another runtime.
red: Omit a session or change its recorded cost in a fixture; totals reconciliation flags the discrepancy.

title: Run the decadal reviewer and adopter pass
scope: Apply skill_decadal_aar: all sixteen reviewer lenses, canonical adopter ranker and preserved parallel scorecard. No synthetic score substitutes for human evidence.
test: All sixteen lenses have evidence and dispositions; capstone primary ranker ≥4.95 on its existing aggregation, secondary dimensions remain separate.
red: Remove one reviewer and merge secondary scores into the primary total; completeness and aggregation checks must fail.

title: Graduate reusable context
scope: Promote validated lessons into local context/doctrine/skills/templates and reviewer/glossary amendments where justified; stage upstream/template-release proposals without editing .adna.
test: Every promoted claim links evidence and an owner; existing indices resolve; no invented provider pattern is embedded locally.
red: A proposed lesson without evidence or a copied provider gate bar must be rejected by graduation review.

title: Prepare the graph-update wave
scope: For every named related graph, record concrete lessons, changes, owners, gates and local-versus-memo disposition. Stage all peer memos inside this vault; deliver none without authority.
test: Every required graph has a row, each actionable row has a concrete proposed diff or memo and destination, and no peer tree was modified.
red: An omitted graph, unowned row or direct peer-write proposal must fail ledger review.

title: Scope follow-up and review cadence
scope: Scope evidence gaps and next campaign without changing launch claims. Assign full review every two quarters, claims/links monthly and TTFS on each quickstart release to named owners.
test: Every unresolved item has an owner, next evidence event and acceptance criterion; schedules remain proposed unless separately authorized.
red: An unresolved issue with no owner or cadence without a trigger must fail handoff review.

title: Ratify closure and file the close splash
scope: Use template_campaign_close_splash; reconcile every mission/AAR/graduation/graph-update row, present P6 operator exit and only then close campaign and STATE.
test: No completed status until P6 is ratified, all mandatory outputs exist and outstanding peer deliveries are explicitly held or accepted as follow-ups.
red: A missing full AAR, omitted graph row or unsigned P6 gate must prevent completed status.
